note: v3: the crawler goes DIRECTLY to each manufacturer's own website and nowhere else. No general web search, no guessed URLs. Adapters verified live on 2026-10-27: Sika (its own search page -> product page -> PDF links), Tremco (its own sitemap -> product page -> PDF links), IKO (its own product/document sitemaps -> product page -> PDF links). Manufacturers with adapter=null have no verified static adapter yet (their catalogues load through JavaScript search, or their API needs a login); for those the crawler reports NOT FOUND with the reason instead of guessing from a web search. To add a manufacturer, add an entry here with an adapter (sika_serp or sitemap) and its sitemap/search URLs — the code does the rest. Set country to CA, US, or ALL. Domains are matched by suffix, so subdomains and asset hosts under the same domain still count.
